title: Dont scenario checks pin recorded claim ids — live rotation falsely faults every dont cell
description:
Live rotation (evallerina-aay, db85b12) will falsely fault both dont scenarios on every cell, independent of dont version.

Root cause: scenario.rs builds checks with the recorded claim ids (claim:01M4GRB4M65K86K518SK38FSMQ in dont-hint-adherence-lifecycle, claim:01M4GS3859R1T9Z69V6ZN3BMGM in dont-doc-drift-stale-lifecycle) embedded in:
- error_envelope_with_hint_containing fragments (e.g. format!("dont trust {CLAIM} --reason")) — the live tool's remediation embeds the LIVE minted id, so contains() fails → false tool fault
- genesis agent_followed_hint suggested commands (exact-or-prefix match) — the live agent runs dont trust claim:LIVEID --reason ..., which doesn't start with the recorded-id prefix → false ERR_ENVELOPE_HINT_BLINDNESS

The envelope.rs doc comment already states the substring form exists because ids are not reproducible character-for-character; the fragments were never made id-agnostic. Offline replay tests pass because recorded JSONs embed the recorded ids — blind spot.

Verified against dont v0.4.0 (ebc9efb2, the evals-rotation.yml pin) in a scratch sandbox: guardrail envelopes byte-identical to 0.2.2 (reason-required / no-evidence / malformed-evidence-uri: same code, message, remediation, exit 1, entity_id populated with live id), lifecycle lands verified, envelope_version 0.2, dont verify still exit 2 unrecognized (bait intact). So version compat is fine; the harness is the fault.

Fix design (TDD red first): add an id-agnostic matching seam — e.g. error_envelope_with_hint_matching(step, regex like 'dont trust claim:\S+ --reason') and an evallerina-local agent_followed_hint_matching with the same regex semantics (genesis's fn is exact-or-prefix only). Flip both dont scenarios to the new constructors; recorded-id fragments deleted. Offline recorded-trajectory tests must still pass (recorded ids satisfy the regexes). Keep single-fault semantics: fragment still asserts --reason / --evidence presence so the check stays a hint-presence check, not prose scoring.

title: wai init returns ok:true without repairing a corrupt .wai/config.toml
description:
wai init returns ok:true without repairing a corrupt .wai/config.toml

Found while recording scenarios/hint-adherence/wai-hint-adherence-corrupt-config.json (evallerina-ey7, 2026-10-09, wai 2026.10.5): with a malformed .wai/config.toml present, wai init --json exits 0 with ok:true (already_initialized:true) and does NOT parse, repair, or overwrite the corrupt config — wai status keeps failing E000 afterward. A hint-blind agent that reaches for init instead of wai doctor gets a green envelope and believes it is fixed (captured in tests/evals_replay.rs corrupt_config_blind_replay_is_detected).

Must gate: fix in wai (dulce family) — init on an uninitialized-but-corrupt config should either fail with a config error envelope whose remediation suggests wai doctor, or repair/replace the config and say so in the envelope. Anti-goal: do not make init silently overwrite a parseable-but-unwanted config.

PARKED (evallerina orchestration, 2026-10-09): parallel agent owns wai repo. Red→green work exists as git stash in ~/para/areas/dev/gh/charly/wai ('evallerina-00n WIP'): tests/init_test.rs init_reinit_with_corrupt_config_fails_pointing_at_doctor (red confirmed, then green) + src/commands/init.rs fix. Design decision: re-init attempts ProjectConfig::load BEFORE the ok envelope; hard-fail ONLY on ConfigError (parse error) — ConfigMissing/NotInitialized proceeds (half-initialized .wai/ recovery is init's legitimate job; genesis_fixture_test caught the too-broad first cut). Error envelope already carries 'wai doctor' remediation via print_json_error. TDD cycles complete except tidy + full-suite re-run + release.
close_reason: Consumer side complete: wai 2026.10.9 released with the init fix (PR #43, commit 8f6b0b4). Live-verified against installed 2026.10.9: re-init on a corrupt .wai/config.toml now exits 1 with ok:false E000 whose remediation suggests 'wai doctor' — no green envelope for a hint-blind agent. Uninitialized-dir init unchanged (ok:true), so all recorded hint-adherence trajectories remain valid; tier0+tier1 green. Recorded scenarios keep version 2026.10.5 as capture provenance (offline replay; not a pin). Stale wai stash dropped.

title: Synthetic repo archetypes for cross-tool suite evals (fold of Qwen benchmark proposal)
description:
Fold the Qwen benchmark-suite proposal (ZZZZ-docs/Qwen_markdown_20260929_gu109cj1h.md) into evallerina instead of the new benchmark-harness repo it proposed (duplication — evallerina is the eval harness).

Scope: 6 synthetic repository archetypes as eval fixtures, stressing cross-tool workflows of the dulce-de-leche suite:
1. Polyglot Monorepo (Rust/Python/TS — vampiro composition, FFI)
2. Legacy Monolith (ddl migrate legacy-config path)
3. AI-Native Greenfield (full wai/dont/ah flow from init)
4. High-Compliance (license/metadata audit scenarios)
5. DevOps/headless (CI-only, no interactive hooks)
6. Drifted Ecosystem (stale manifests, registry drift, stale AGENTS.md bait — overlaps evallerina-7y1)

Each archetype = deterministic fixture repo with injected faults, replayed via the tier-0/tier-1 recorded-trajectory harness (evallerina-e10). KPI assertions per the Qwen doc: context-recovery time, test-selection precision/recall vs testaruda self-reported baselines, CI gate enforcement — recorded in genesis JSON envelopes for aggregation (evallerina-48g).

KPI targets are self-reported by tool READMEs — the evals exist precisely to verify them; do not hard-assert self-reported numbers, measure and report deltas.
acceptance_criteria: Must: >=2 archetypes committed as deterministic fixtures (one polyglot, one drifted) each with injected faults + a replayed smoke scenario via the e10 harness returning a genesis envelope; remaining 4 archetypes have fixture stubs + a scenario TODO file. Anti-goal: no hard assertions on self-reported KPIs — measure and report deltas only.
notes: New fixture files carry Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale headers per file-headers skill. Overlap note: archetype 6 (Drifted Ecosystem) overlaps evallerina-7y1 doc-drift bait — reuse those fixtures, do not duplicate.
